newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank sells Deutsche BA stake to BA.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank sells Deutsche BA stake to BA.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Friday it would sell its 16 percent stake in airline Deutsche BA to the German airline's parent British Airways Plc, giving the British carrier a controlling interest.
Vereinsbank said the sale needed approval from cartel office authorities. The bank had said in April that it wanted to sell its stake in Deutsche BA sometime in July.
British Airways will raise its stake in the airline to 65 percent through the acquisition of Vereinsbank's shares, up from the prior level of 49 percent.
British Airways had been required by British law to carry Deutsche BA's losses on its books and is also responsible for operation of the airline.
Other major shareholders in Deutsche BA are Germany's Commerzbank AG with a 19 percent stake and Berliner Bank with a 16 percent stake. The airline said those stakes would remain intact.
Vereinsbank bought the stake in Deutsche BA when it was founded five years ago.

Deutsche BA chief executive Carl Michel dismissed reports saying Vereinsbank sold the Deutsche BA stake because of complaints from Lufthansa AG chief executive Juergen Weber to the bank about doing business with both carriers.
He said talks may be held with other possible investors interested in buying a stake in the European airline.
"We would be happy to enter into talks with other interested parties," Michel said.
